title: HTTP designer response
description: The JSON body an HTTP-bound filter designer returns -- design/designer-interface.md §7.1, decoded caller-side by pipeline.designer.http_binding.http_designer(). DesignResponse (§3) as JSON, field-for-field; unlike the request, nothing here needs binary encoding, since a BiquadSpec carries no sample-rate-bound data by design (§5). Anything that doesn't match this shape is treated as an implementation failure (HttpDesignerError), never coerced into a decline -- see §1/§7.1.

candidates.description: success: a non-empty array, best (most preferred) first -- candidates[0] is the only one the caller acts on automatically. Absent/null on decline. No entry may carry rejection_reasons.

rejected.description: 1.1, with either shape: designs built and judged unfit to publish, for human review only -- never applied, simulated for publication, or published (§3, 'rejected'). Exempt from the confidence ordering rule. Absent/null when there are none.

decline_reason.description: decline: a short, stable, machine-usable snake_case code (§4). Absent/null on success.

design_version.description: 1.4, optional: the designer's design version, bumped by any change that can alter an answer to the same request (beyond a small tolerance); 0 means before versioning. design/design-version.md.

design_settings.description: 1.4, optional: an opaque digest, equal between two designers exactly when their non-default settings that can alter an answer are equal.

designer_build.description: 1.4, optional: the designer's build, for people; a caller keys nothing on it.

confidence.description: ordinal in v1 -- comparable within this response's candidates, not across titles or implementations

mv_adjust_db.description: the cascade's implied gain (catalogue mv_adjust compatibility) -- NOT a clipping-cost estimate

residual_db.description: max absolute error, dB, of filters against the target they were fitted to, over residual_band_hz, measured on the cascade as published and as the device plays it (canonical rounding and coefficient quantisation at the device rate)

residual_at_hz.description: 1.3: where |error| equals residual_db, within residual_band_hz; present exactly when residual_direction is

residual_direction.description: 1.3: 'over' -- the filters boost more than the target at residual_at_hz; 'under' -- less

residual_rms_db.description: 1.3: RMS error over residual_band_hz, weighted by the boost the target asks for (max(target_db, 0)); never more than residual_db; null when the target asks for no boost in the band

residual_within_tolerance.description: 1.3: the share of the requested boost (same weighting) within residual_tolerance_db of the target -- not a probability, not a verdict

residual_tolerance_db.description: 1.3: the tolerance residual_within_tolerance is measured with; present exactly when it is

commentary.description: structured, human-facing notes -- dict[str, str]; not machine-parsed

rejection_reasons.description: 1.1: why this design was judged unfit to publish -- required and non-empty in rejected, null/absent in candidates; human-facing, not machine-parsed
